_comment: Headline coverage figures: the only file to edit for them. The homepage, docs/coverage and llms.txt read it at build time. A value left as its own {{NAME}} token renders as a visible placeholder; `npm run build` warns, and `npm run check:figures` fails, while any is left. A value of null hides the figure: the homepage drops the block marked <!-- figure:NAME --> for it, and docs pages render it only where shown(NAME) allows; used anywhere else, it still renders as its {{NAME}} token.
_sources: The syntax figures come from `cargo run --release -p sqlquack-syntax-coverage -- summary` on main, which counts the catalogue against the auditor's review records in coverage/syntax/reviews, not from coverage/syntax/baseline.json, which is bound to an older catalogue. SYNTAX_FORMS is that count's denominator and SYNTAX_PCT its verified share. The translation figures are hidden (null) until their definition is decided.
SYNTAX_BASIS: 2,388 forms verified against cases recorded on Snowflake and approved reviews, as of 6 November 2026.
